target.title: fix: Control UI avatar initial breaks on emoji display names
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When an agent's display name begins with an emoji or other astral Unicode character, the Control UI renders a broken/garbled avatar initial (a lone UTF-16 surrogate half) instead of the intended glyph, because the fallback uses `.slice(0, 1)` / `[0]` (first UTF-16 code unit).

## Summary

- **Solution**: one shared grapheme-boundary owner — `takeGraphemes` in `ui/src/lib/grapheme.ts` (`Intl.Segmenter`, `granularity: "grapheme"`, with a code-point fallback) — consumed by both the existing plugin monogram (`ui/src/pages/plugins/presentation.ts`, replacing its local copy) and `deriveAvatarInitial` (`ui/src/lib/avatar.ts`). No second grapheme implementation remains.
- **The four live avatar fallback surfaces** now route through that owner via `deriveAvatarInitial(...) || "?"`:
  - `ui/src/components/app-sidebar.ts` — sidebar agent card avatar
  - `ui/src/components/app-sidebar-agent-menu.ts` — agent menu row initial
  - `ui/src/components/agent-select.ts` — agent selector dropdown fallback
  - `ui/src/pages/agents/panels-overview.ts` — agents overview identity editor avatar
- **Rebased onto current `main`** (`556a2ee276f`, single commit). The upstream sidebar refactor renamed the chip to `openclaw-sidebar-agent-card`; the fix was reapplied at the new `cardAvatarText` site and the E2E selectors were updated to match (`sidebar-agent-card__main`, `sidebar-agent-card__avatar-text`).
- **What did NOT change**: ASCII names render identically; no behavior change to avatar URLs or the plugin monogram output.

## Evidence

**Live Control UI/Gateway proof** (no mocks): real built CLI (`pnpm install && pnpm build`, `node openclaw.mjs gateway run --port 18991`) with an isolated scratch state dir and a config declaring two agents (`main` = "Main", `emoji` = "🚀Rocket"). A real Chromium session (Playwright, no mocked Gateway) authenticated with a scratch loopback token read the rendered DOM of each surface. Terminal trace:

```text
$ node capture-live-proof.mjs   # drives http://127.0.0.1:18991/ (real gateway)
{
  "menuAvatar": "🚀",      // sidebar agent menu row (wa-dropdown-item[value="agent:emoji"])
  "cardAvatar": "🚀",      // sidebar agent card after switching to the emoji agent
  "selectAvatar": "M",     // agent-select trigger shows the selected agent (Main)
  "overviewAvatar": "🚀",  // agents overview identity editor
  "errors": []
}
$ node recapture-select.mjs      // agents page dropdown, open state
{"itemAvatar":"🚀"}             // agent-select dropdown item for 🚀Rocket
```

Redacted screenshots from the same live session (loopback gateway, scratch config, no real endpoints/credentials):

- Sidebar agent menu: https://github.com/xydigit-zt/xydigit-zt-openclaw/releases/download/pr-104912-proof/live-01-agent-menu.png
- Sidebar agent card after switching to 🚀Rocket: https://github.com/xydigit-zt/xydigit-zt-openclaw/releases/download/pr-104912-proof/live-02-sidebar-card.png
- Agents page selector dropdown: https://github.com/xydigit-zt/xydigit-zt-openclaw/releases/download/pr-104912-proof/live-03-agent-select.png
- Agents overview identity editor: https://github.com/xydigit-zt/xydigit-zt-openclaw/releases/download/pr-104912-proof/live-04-agents-overview.png

**Mocked-Gateway Chromium E2E** (deterministic regression lane, real browser DOM asserted `.toBe("🚀")` on all four surfaces):

```text
$ OPENCLAW_CAPTURE_UI_PROOF=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
    --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts \
    ui/src/e2e/avatar-initial-emoji.e2e.test.ts
✓ renders the emoji grapheme initial in the sidebar chip and agent menu row
✓ renders the emoji grapheme initial in the agent selector dropdown
✓ renders the emoji grapheme initial in the agents overview identity editor
Test Files  1 passed (1)   Tests  3 passed (3)
```

**Unit + component tests**:

```text
$ pnpm test ui/src/lib/avatar.test.ts ui/src/lib/grapheme.test.ts ui/src/components/agent-select.test.ts
Test Files  3 passed (3)   Tests  23 passed (23)
```

`pnpm tsgo:ui` exit 0; `oxfmt`/`oxlint` clean on touched files; `git diff --check` clean.

## Regression Test Plan

- `ui/src/lib/grapheme.test.ts` — shared slicer: ASCII, emoji, ZWJ family, flags, skin-tone, empty input, plus the `Intl.Segmenter`-unavailable code-point fallback (fresh module import under stub).
- `ui/src/lib/avatar.test.ts` — `deriveAvatarInitial` behavior via the shared owner.
- `ui/src/components/agent-select.test.ts` — component fallback keeps the full cluster (`👨‍👩‍👧‍👦`).
- `ui/src/e2e/avatar-initial-emoji.e2e.test.ts` — all four live surfaces in real Chromium.

What was not tested: every possible Unicode boundary was not enumerated; the proof targets the four known live `.slice(0,1)`/`[0]` avatar-initial surfaces and the documented fallback path. The plugin monogram's rendered output is unchanged (same algorithm, shared source).
